guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 用流量收支、重力排水與泵站備援管理隧道湧水。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Manage tunnel inflow through flow balance, gravity drainage and pump redundancy. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 假想檢核 1：地下水與施工用水收支；Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage
假想檢核 2：支管流速與有效斷面；Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s
假想檢核 5：集水容量與反應時間；storageNeeded=Q*t=0.055 m3/s*600 s=33 m3
假想檢核 6：備援容量與共同失效；remainingCapacity=2*40 L/s=80 L/s after one of three equal pumps fails
CEDD 岩洞指南第二版出版於 2018 年，並非本課的實測報告
FHWA 官方典藏將隧道土木手冊出版日期記為 2009 年
factsEn: Assumed check 1: Groundwater and process-water balance; Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage
Assumed check 2: Branch velocity and effective area; Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s
Assumed check 4: Pump head and power; Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, Q=0.055 m3/s, H=20 m, eta=0.70; P=rho*g*Q*H/eta=1000*9.81*0.055*20/0.70=15416 W=15.4 kW
Assumed check 5: Sump storage and response time; storageNeeded=Q*t=0.055 m3/s*600 s=33 m3
Assumed check 6: Redundancy and common failures; remainingCapacity=2*40 L/s=80 L/s after one of three equal pumps fails
CEDD issued its second cavern guide in 2018; it is not a measurement report for these examples
The FHWA official archive dates the civil tunnel manual to 2009
timeline: 1992　CEDD 出版岩洞工程指南第一版，建立公開技術框架

timelineEn: 1992 — CEDD publishes its first cavern-engineering guide as a public technical framework
2009 — The FHWA civil tunnel manual consolidates excavation and lining methods
2018 — The second CEDD cavern guide updates ground and support assessment

CEDD 岩土指南第四冊：岩洞工程第二版
codesEn: FHWA Technical Manual for Design and Construction of Road Tunnels - Civil Elements
CEDD Geoguide 4: Guide to Cavern Engineering second edition

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出埋深或斷面、地質水文、支護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, ground and groundwater, support system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：隧道湧水排導系統
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Tunnel inflow collection and drainage
guides.concept: 本課以用流量收支、重力排水與泵站備援管理隧道湧水為主線，從地下水與施工用水收支與支管流速與有效斷面建立系統邊界，再把集水容量與反應時間、堵塞敏感度與維護連到長期水文與維護交接。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
guides.conceptEn: This course focuses on manage tunnel inflow through flow balance, gravity drainage and pump redundancy. It begins with Groundwater and process-water balance and Branch velocity and effective area, links Sump storage and response time and Blockage sensitivity and maintenance, and ends with Long-term hydrology and handover. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
procedure: 排水總量同時包含地層湧水、施工用水和儲存變化，不能全部算成天然地下水。泵站啟停造成出水脈動，應在相同時間窗比較流入與流出；若水槽水位改變，還須加入庫容項才可辨認真正湧水趨勢。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化；若出現施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
支管輸水能力受實際有效斷面影響，沉積、變形和局部堵塞都會改變速度與水位。用公稱管徑計算可能漏掉積泥，量測高流速也不一定表示容量充足，因為上游可能已積水；應同時看流量、斷面與水頭。 判別這個機制時，應觀察量測流速、積泥厚度及上游水位以還原有效斷面；若出現積泥縮小斷面導致水位抬升，名義管徑仍看似足夠，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
重力排水依靠水面或能量坡降，管底設計坡度不一定等於實際水力坡降。接頭錯台與局部反坡會形成積泥，端點高程正確也可能漏掉中段低窪；Manning 模型只在定義清楚的均勻流條件下提供基準。 判別這個機制時，應觀察沿線水準與管內影像共同查核反坡、錯台及沉積；若出現中段沉陷形成水袋，兩端坡度合格卻持續堵塞，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
泵站需要克服靜揚程、沿程損失及局部損失，額定流量只對應特定工作點。效率隨工況改變，不能將馬達功率直接等同水力輸出；並聯泵也不一定讓流量倍增，因為系統曲線會隨流量上升。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較實測流量、吸排壓差與輸入功率對應工作點；若出現沿程阻力增大把泵推離有效工況，耗電高但排水不足，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
集水槽提供短暫流量緩衝，實際可用容量要扣除沉積、最低運轉水位與不可用空間。以總幾何容積除湧水量會高估反應時間，泵停機後流入也可能變化；需使用可用容量和明確情境，而非把時間當成工作許可。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對槽內有效水位區間、沉積量及停泵水位上升紀錄；若出現沉積佔用緩衝容量，停機後比預估更快溢流，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
備用泵能處理單機故障，卻不能自動解決共用電源、吸水口或排水幹管失效。備援評估應沿完整鏈找共同點，並檢查切換期間儲存量；設備數量多不代表功能獨立，需要以故障情境而非台數證明韌性。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐一核對電源、控制、吸水和排水共用點及切換試驗；若出現全部泵共用堵塞吸水口，備用機雖正常也無法排水，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。

沉積會同時減少面積與水力半徑，輸水能力下降可能快於直徑比例。此直徑尺度關係假定幾何相似的圓形有效通道滿流，Manning n 與能量坡度不變；任意底部沉積形狀或部分滿流不能沿用同一冪次。清理效果應以恢復後水位和流量驗證，而不只看清出多少沉積物。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較清理前後有效斷面、水位與相同流量下壓降；若出現只清可見口部而保留深部堵塞，水位很快再次抬升，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
排水需要讓水通過又限制地層細粒移動，濾層不相容會引起內部侵蝕或快速堵塞。出水突然變濁可能反映顆粒流失，但施工泥水也能造成類似現象；應結合粒徑、流量和地表變形，避免只以清澈程度判定穩定。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比對濾層粒徑、濁度、排水量與附近沉陷趨勢；若出現細粒被帶走形成隱藏空洞，出水量正常仍可能損失地層，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
排水水質管理應同時看濃度和流量，低濃度的大流量仍可能有很大污染物質量。沉澱槽處理懸浮固體不等於去除溶解物，應按成分選擇驗證量；課程的質量帳只描述工程尺度，不取代所在地排放要求。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步取樣流量與代表性濃度並比較處理前後質量收支；若出現只看濃度降低忽略稀釋增流，總污染質量其實未下降，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
隧道排水可能長期改變周邊地下水位，運轉資料需要與降雨、泉水和鄰地沉陷共同解讀。不同季節的同一流量不一定代表相同地層狀態，感測器和排水改造也會改變基準；交接應保存來源分區和維護歷程。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將降雨、地下水位、分區排水與清理事件共同分析；若出現把季節乾旱全歸因隧道排水，或忽略持續抽排的影響，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
procedureEn: Discharge combines groundwater, process water and storage change rather than natural inflow alone. Pump cycling makes outlet flow intermittent, requiring equal accounting windows. Include changing sump volume to identify the underlying groundwater trend instead of confusing operational pulses with geology. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes. If higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Branch performance depends on effective area altered by sediment, deformation and blockage. Nominal diameter can miss deposits, and high velocity does not prove spare capacity if water is already backing up. Interpret flow, section geometry and head together rather than velocity alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure velocity, deposit depth and upstream level to reconstruct effective area. If sediment reduces area and raises head while nominal diameter still appears adequate, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Gravity drainage follows a water-surface or energy gradient, which need not equal the designed invert grade. Steps and reverse slopes trap sediment despite correct endpoints. Manning's equation gives a baseline only under a clearly defined uniform-flow condition, not arbitrary backwater or pressurized flow. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Use longitudinal levels and internal images to check reverse slopes, steps and deposits. If a midline sag traps water and repeatedly blocks despite acceptable endpoint grade, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Pumps overcome static lift, friction and local losses, with rated flow tied to a duty point. Efficiency changes with operation, so motor power is not hydraulic output. Parallel pumps need not double discharge because the system curve rises with total flow. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare measured flow, suction-discharge pressure difference and input power at the duty point. If growing line resistance shifts duty away from efficient operation, using power without adequate drainage, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

A sump buffers temporary imbalance, with usable storage reduced by sediment, minimum operating levels and dead space. Gross volume divided by inflow overstates response time, while inflow can change after pump failure. Use available storage under a stated scenario rather than treating the time as permission to act. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check usable level range, sediment and observed level rise during approved pump tests. If sediment consumes buffer storage and overflow occurs sooner than predicted, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

A standby pump addresses one unit's failure but not shared power, intake or discharge-line loss. Trace common dependencies and storage during transfer. More equipment does not establish functional independence; demonstrate resilience through failure scenarios rather than pump count alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit shared power, control, intake and discharge points alongside transfer tests. If all pumps share a blocked intake, so a healthy standby still cannot drain, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Deposits reduce both area and hydraulic radius, making capacity fall faster than diameter alone. The scaling assumes geometrically similar circular effective passages flowing full, with unchanged Manning n and energy slope. Arbitrary bottom deposits or partially full flow do not follow the same diameter exponent. Verify cleaning by recovered head and flow rather than the removed sediment mass alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare effective section, level and pressure loss at equal flow before and after cleaning. If cleaning only the visible outlet leaves deep blockage and head quickly rises again, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Drainage must pass water while retaining ground fines; incompatible filters can erode internally or clog quickly. Turbidity may indicate soil loss but also construction slurry. Combine particle distribution, flow and ground movement rather than judging stability solely from water clarity. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare filter grading, turbidity, discharge and nearby settlement trends. If escaping fines create hidden voids despite apparently normal discharge, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Water management needs both concentration and flow: dilute high-volume discharge can carry a large mass. Settling removes suspended solids rather than every dissolved species, requiring constituent-specific verification. The mass balance describes engineering scale and does not replace local discharge requirements. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Sample representative concentration and flow together and compare treatment mass balances. If concentration falls through dilution while total discharged contaminant mass remains unchanged, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Tunnel drainage can alter regional groundwater over time, requiring interpretation with rainfall, springs and settlement. Equal seasonal flows need not represent equal ground conditions, while sensor or drainage changes shift baselines. Preserve source zones and maintenance history for later assessment. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Analyze rainfall, groundwater levels, zoned discharge and cleaning events together. If seasonal drought is entirely blamed on drainage, or persistent drainage effects are ignored, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
evidence: 將同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
將量測流速、積泥厚度及上游水位以還原有效斷面列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現積泥縮小斷面導致水位抬升，名義管徑仍看似足夠，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
將沿線水準與管內影像共同查核反坡、錯台及沉積列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現中段沉陷形成水袋，兩端坡度合格卻持續堵塞，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
將比較實測流量、吸排壓差與輸入功率對應工作點列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現沿程阻力增大把泵推離有效工況，耗電高但排水不足，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
將核對槽內有效水位區間、沉積量及停泵水位上升紀錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現沉積佔用緩衝容量，停機後比預估更快溢流，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
evidenceEn: Apply the following check at handover: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Apply the following check at handover: Measure velocity, deposit depth and upstream level to reconstruct effective area. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If sediment reduces area and raises head while nominal diameter still appears adequate, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Apply the following check at handover: Use longitudinal levels and internal images to check reverse slopes, steps and deposits. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a midline sag traps water and repeatedly blocks despite acceptable endpoint grade, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Apply the following check at handover: Compare measured flow, suction-discharge pressure difference and input power at the duty point. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If growing line resistance shifts duty away from efficient operation, using power without adequate drainage, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Apply the following check at handover: Check usable level range, sediment and observed level rise during approved pump tests. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If sediment consumes buffer storage and overflow occurs sooner than predicted, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
pitfalls: 施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
中段沉陷形成水袋，兩端坡度合格卻持續堵塞。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到沿線水準與管內影像共同查核反坡、錯台及沉積，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
沉積佔用緩衝容量，停機後比預估更快溢流。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對槽內有效水位區間、沉積量及停泵水位上升紀錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
只清可見口部而保留深部堵塞，水位很快再次抬升。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較清理前後有效斷面、水位與相同流量下壓降，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
只看濃度降低忽略稀釋增流，總污染質量其實未下降。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步取樣流量與代表性濃度並比較處理前後質量收支，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
pitfallsEn: Higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

A midline sag traps water and repeatedly blocks despite acceptable endpoint grade. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to use longitudinal levels and internal images to check reverse slopes, steps and deposits to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

Sediment consumes buffer storage and overflow occurs sooner than predicted. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check usable level range, sediment and observed level rise during approved pump tests to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

Cleaning only the visible outlet leaves deep blockage and head quickly rises again. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare effective section, level and pressure loss at equal flow before and after cleaning to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

Concentration falls through dilution while total discharged contaminant mass remains unchanged. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to sample representative concentration and flow together and compare treatment mass balances to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

related.title: 既有隧道漏水修繕
related.transfer: 可遷移「地下水與施工用水收支」與「堵塞敏感度與維護」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；既有隧道漏水修繕的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Groundwater and process-water balance" and "Blockage sensitivity and maintenance" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Leakage repair in existing tunnels must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦用流量收支、重力排水與泵站備援管理隧道湧水；既有隧道漏水修繕則以以水源診斷、活動裂縫與修補相容性處理既有隧道漏水為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on manage tunnel inflow through flow balance, gravity drainage and pump redundancy; Leakage repair in existing tunnels centres on repair existing-tunnel leakage through source diagnosis, active-crack assessment and material compatibility, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「地下水與施工用水收支」與「凝結與地下水來源」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到既有隧道漏水修繕，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「排水保留與壓力轉移」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Groundwater and process-water balance” and “Condensation and groundwater sources”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Leakage repair in existing tunnels, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Drainage preservation and pressure transfer", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 隧道湧水排導系統
history.text: 本課討論的用流量收支、重力排水與泵站備援管理隧道湧水，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on manage tunnel inflow through flow balance, gravity drainage and pump redundancy reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
